title: Bounded edit distance

problem.name: Bounded edit distance
problem.statement_latex: Given $A,B\in\Sigma^{\le n}$ and $k\ge1$, compute their edit distance and an optimal edit sequence if the distance is at most $k$, and otherwise report that it exceeds $k$. Insertions, deletions and substitutions have unit cost; characters are queried by index.
problem.statement_text: Given $A,B\in\Sigma^{\le n}$ and $k\ge1$, compute their edit distance and an optimal edit sequence if the distance is at most $k$, and otherwise report that it exceeds $k$. Insertions, deletions and substitutions have unit cost; characters are queried by index.
